text:
Situation: Baclofen 20 mg tablets are not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 199 tablets (34.2 days on hand at 5.8 tablets per day). Corvale General holds 198 tablets (23.9 days on hand at 8.3 tablets per day). Corvale Lakeside holds 54 tablets (28.1 days on hand at 1.9 tablets per day).

Why (FDA record): FDA records show Bryant Ranch Prepack (FEI 1000519407), the plant named on the label for NDC 71335249700, received an OAI classification in 2009 and a Warning Letter on 2010-04-08, followed by multiple VAI inspections through 2026-07-16. The most recent inspection was VAI on 2026-07-16. Baclofen is not listed on FDA's shortage list.

Our position: Current inventory across three sites provides 23.9 to 34.2 days of supply. No FDA shortage listing exists. The primary labeled manufacturer has a historical compliance record but recent VAI status. Alternate manufacturers are not on FDA's shortage list but their plant locations are unverified.

Recommended actions:
1. Continue current allocation and monitor daily usage at all three sites (buyer approves).
2. Qualify Advagen Pharma Limited as an alternate source pending plant verification (buyer and quality assurance approve).
3. Qualify Advanced Rx Pharmacy of Tennessee, LLC as an alternate source pending plant verification (buyer and quality assurance approve).
4. Qualify Aurobindo Pharma Limited as an alternate source pending plant verification (buyer and quality assurance approve).
5. Report inventory status to P&T committee monthly until all sites exceed 60 days on hand (buyer approves).

Not recommended: Initiate therapeutic alternatives or formulary changes based on current supply.
